name: LootBot xLoot staking redeem pays each duplicated NFT id in the input array
summary: LootBot Staking.redeem(uint256[] xloots) computes the reward in the view _redeemable by accruing each listed xLoot NFT's ETH per epoch, and only afterwards writes each id's nextRedeem marker. Repeated ids in the array are therefore each paid. The attacker redeemed with a single owned id repeated 10 to 1,984 times in seven direct calls on 2026-04-08. On 2026-04-15 it flash-borrowed 2.1 ETH from Balancer and sent it to the contract to open a new epoch. It then redeemed seven ids repeated about 155 times each, taking 6.21 ETH.

loss.notes: Campaign 1 (2026-04-08, blocks 24835237..24835508, seven direct redeem calls by 0xacdcd2e9): the contract paid 2.625696793184068608 ETH; each call listed one owned id n times, so the payout times (n-1)/n, 2.622144009704757525 ETH, is counted as excess. Campaign 2 (2026-04-15, source-2): contract ETH balance fell by 4.10983297318446132 ETH net of the attacker's own 2.1 ETH epoch deposit; the attack contract's single-copy entitlement for its seven ids, payout/155 = 0.040063438536673944 ETH, is deducted, leaving 4.069769534647787376 ETH. The Balancer flash loan is financing.

ageReset.description: The TransparentUpgradeableProxy constructor's Upgraded(0xf3a3648b...) is the only Upgraded event before the exploit; the Staking implementation has been active since proxy creation.

sources.note: Lead: SlowMist/Defimon alert (source-10) names tx source-2 and victim 0x9d87ff19. Etherscan txlist of the proxy to 24885768 (3,131 txs, complete): decoding every successful redeem(uint256[]) (0xf9afb26a) input finds exactly seven with repeated ids, all from EOA 0xacdcd2e9787e889305200900d6cf6c0548578630: source-1 24835237:121 (id 128 x10), 0x779ad577 24835239:44 (id 144 x10), 0x3cf88c22 24835504:0 (id 145 x1126), 0x2b4dd3d6 24835505:33 (id 195 x1126), 0xe5180327 24835506:49 (id 49 x1984), 0x56ba09f4 24835507:7 (id 51 x1984), 0x7bb7861f 24835508:3 (id 52 x1984); txlistinternal payouts from the proxy 7809014176852260, 7809014176852260, 879294996313564476 x2, 283829590734411712 x3 wei. Of 1,550 payout transactions, the only one not sent directly to the proxy is source-2 (24885768:3): attack contract 0xd8a948b2 pulls 7 xLoot NFTs from the EOA, flash-loans 2.1 WETH from Balancer, unwraps, sends 2.1 ETH to the proxy (receive opens an epoch), calls redeem with 7 ids repeated (69,578-byte calldata), receives 6.209832973184461 ETH, repays and sends 4.109832973184461 ETH to the EOA. Verified Staking source (source-9): redeem -> _redeemLoot -> _redeemable loops over xloots accumulating per-epoch ETH for each entry with no duplicate check; _redeemLoot writes nextRedeem[id] only after the full-array computation. Target: proxy created by source-3 at 18834095:135 from 0x50de00357b4c96defe9780bc285dc939bbb5ea2e (code empty at 18834094; runtime keccak 0x4d9be648... at 24835236 and 24885767); eth_getLogs Upgraded (0xbc7cd75a) on the proxy to 24885768: only log 282 of source-3 (-> 0xf3a3648b); EIP-1967 slot 0xf3a3648b at 24835236 and 24885767. Implementation created by source-4 at 18834093 from the same deployer; code empty at 18834092; keccak 0x785c21acee0942a23ce1539d0a054f9e2a0d1f58e71a99fd10a0661da0c40853 at 18834093, 24835236 and 24885767; no DELEGATECALL/SELFDESTRUCT. codeAgeSeconds = 1775654291 - 1703159951 = 72494340.

Loss: eth_getBalance(proxy 0x9d87ff196646a99bddb16876066aa863900118b4) 6824888420246842627 at 24835236 and 4199191627062774019 at 24835508 (the seven campaign-1 payouts, total 2625696793184068608 wei); excess sum of payout x (n-1)/n = 2622144009704757525 wei, valued at the DefiLlama WETH price 2263.1544809230427 (source-7) = 5,934.32 USD. Campaign 2: eth_getBalance(proxy) 4209191627062774020 at 24885767 and 99358653878312700 at 24885768 (-4109832973184461320 after the attacker's 2.1 ETH deposit). debug_traceTransaction(source-2, callTracer): 0xd8a948b2 calls redeem (0xf9afb26a) with 1,085 ids = 49, 51, 52, 128, 144, 145, 195 x155 each; xLootNextReem(id) = 46 for all seven and nextEpocId() = 47 at 24885767, so every copy of an id earns the same epn sum; payout 6209832973184461320 / 155 = 40063438536673944 wei (exact) is the one-copy entitlement. Excess 4109832973184461320 - 40063438536673944 = 4069769534647787376 wei at 2329.0965056140876 (source-8) = 9,478.89 USD. Total 15,413.21 USD.

Verified Staking implementation source at https://etherscan.io/address/0xf3a3648bb1da9d3aea107da77e6f5ba9cf313127#code; reproduce with Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=1: ContractName Staking, v0.8.20+commit.a1b79de6, optimizer 200 runs, SHA-256 of returned SourceCode 84bab16977b3c3a53e85c645adfb9be9aac0897234cf5fb8d4fe60bd4c7f7376. Inspect redeem, _redeemLoot and _redeemable.
